sugyot.title_en: (entertained inference) our mishna implies: if the writer says 'give it', the found document is delivered -- even long after it was lost
if where each has a financial association and each might own all of it Sumchos divides without an oath, then where neither has any association -- and it may belong to both -- all the more so
owner of nine plus the doubtful animal is exempt whichever way: if it is his, he tithed well; if the priest's, nine are not subject to tithe
Rebbi: the jointly-grasped note must be ratified through its signatories (and then the creditor collects)
rider against leader: which acquires? Every תא שמע is deflected; no verdict is recorded
